server.name: wirechunk
server.title: Wirechunk
server.description: Build and update websites on Wirechunk.

protocolMetadata.instructions: See skills at https://app.wirechunk.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json. Use activate_skill for matching workflows. Use search_openapi_schema and read_openapi_schema for API requests. When the user wants something Wirechunk doesn’t support or runs into another problem with Wirechunk, say so and offer to send feedback to Wirechunk with send_product_feedback. Send feedback only after the user agrees.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Wirechunk to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Wirechunk to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.wirechunk.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Wirechunk MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 15, 2026, Wirechunk scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is Wirechunk's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 15, 2026, Wirechunk scores 60/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 15 of 15 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Wirechunk?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Wirechunk in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: How can Wirechunk improve its MCP documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: activate_skill is the lowest-scoring reviewed tool at 39/100. 0 of 1 inputs have descriptions. Add descriptions to the missing inputs, including where to obtain IDs and how to supply values. Open its review for feedback and a copyable fix prompt, then rerun the documentation review after updating your tool metadata.
